[LTIM.14.3] **A call over constants is a constant.** A `calendar` call whose
arguments all fold is foldable ([LEXP.8.8]) in every position, and it is the
value it names: `const LAUNCH = calendar.time(2026, 1, 1)` declares a `Time`
constant, and the same call in a `where` is that constant. It lowers as
[RLOW.6.1.8] states. The compiler must refuse such a call whose fold would raise
[LTIM.14.2]'s fault, with `DS_VALIDATE_CONST_NOT_FOLDABLE`, wherever it stands
and whether or not the rest of the expression would absorb its result: the call
has no value to fold to. The engine evaluates a call with an argument that does
not fold when the rule runs, and a call that raises raises there.
